gloss: new address; where one has moved to

definitions.explanation: The place or address to which a person has moved or is moving; the destination of a relocation. Often used for mail forwarding and change-of-address notices.

examples.japanese: {転居先|てんきょさき}を{知|し}らせる。
examples.english: To notify others of one's new address.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}が{転居先|てんきょさき}に{転送|てんそう}された。
examples.english: The letter was forwarded to the new address.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら、{転居先|てんきょさき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{役所|やくしょ}に{届|とど}け{出|で}る。
examples.english: After moving, you report your new address to the city office.

notes:
Composed of {転居|てんきょ} (moving residence) + {先|さき} (destination, place). The suffix {先|さき} marks a destination or contact point, as in {連絡先|れんらくさき} (contact) or {勤務先|きんむさき} (place of employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転居先|てんきょさき}{不明|ふめい}: new address unknown (as stamped on returned mail)
- {転居先|てんきょさき}を{通知|つうち}する: to give notice of one's new address

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}: place one is moving to — more casual, everyday phrasing
- {新居|しんきょ}: new home — the residence itself rather than its address
